summary: OceanaGold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release that is merely a scheduling notice: Q3 2026 operational and financial results will be released after market close on November 4, 2026, with a conference call and webcast on November 5, 2026, at 10:00am ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report (US equivalent: Form 8-K) and presents no special-situation or risk-arb angle; watch only the eventual quarterly results for operational updates.
